review.notes:
1. Screen recording (iPhone, latest iOS): {VIDEO}
The recording starts by launching the Tune Shifter app, turns the extension on in Settings, opens a page with audio in Safari and uses the extension (speed, preserve pitch, reverb). There is no account, login, user-generated content or paid content.

2. Purpose and audience: Tune Shifter is a Safari Web Extension for people who listen to music, podcasts, lectures or videos on the web and want to change how they sound: slow down or speed up playback (with or without keeping the original pitch), and add reverb. Typical users are musicians practising along with a song, students watching lectures faster, and listeners who like slowed + reverb versions of songs. Safari has no built-in way to do this.

3. How to test: open the Tune Shifter app, which explains how to turn the extension on (iPhone/iPad: Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions > Tune Shifter, turn it on and allow it on all websites; Mac: Safari > Settings > Extensions > Tune Shifter). Then in Safari open any page with audio or video, for example https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/transcoded/6/68/Kevin_MacLeod_-_Erik_Satie_Gymnopedie_No_1.ogg/Kevin_MacLeod_-_Erik_Satie_Gymnopedie_No_1.ogg.mp3 , start playback and open Tune Shifter from the page menu (iPhone, the puzzle icon in the address bar), the extensions icon (iPad) or the toolbar (Mac). Move the Speed slider or tap a preset, toggle Preserve Pitch, and turn on Reverb. No login or sample files are needed.

4. External services: none. The extension works entirely on the device with the browser's own media and Web Audio APIs. It makes no network requests, has no analytics, ads or AI services, and collects no data.

5. Regional differences: none. The app and extension work the same in all regions.

6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not applicable. The extension only changes playback of media that the user is already playing in Safari; it does not download, store or redistribute any content.

pt-PT.name: Tune Shifter
pt-PT.subtitle: Velocidade, tom e reverb
pt-PT.promotionalText: Abranda uma aula de guitarra, acelera um podcast ou junta reverb a uma playlist, em qualquer site, diretamente no Safari.
pt-PT.description:
O Tune Shifter dá-te controlo sobre qualquer áudio ou vídeo no Safari.

• Velocidade: de 0,5x a 2x, com atalhos rápidos
• Manter o tom: muda a velocidade sem a voz ficar mais aguda ou mais grave (ou desliga-o para o efeito “slowed”)
• Reverb: junta profundidade ao som, em tempo real
• Volume: controla o volume do leitor da página (no Mac)
• As definições ficam guardadas por site e passam para os vídeos seguintes

Funciona nos sites de vídeo e música que usas todos os dias.

Como ligar:
• iPhone e iPad: Definições > Apps > Safari > Extensões > Tune Shifter
• Mac: Safari > Definições > Extensões > Tune Shifter

Sem contas, sem anúncios e sem recolha de dados. A extensão só atua nos sites a que lhe deres acesso.

en-GB.name: Tune Shifter
en-GB.subtitle: Speed, pitch and reverb
en-GB.promotionalText: Slow down a guitar lesson, speed up a podcast or add reverb to a playlist, on any site, right in Safari.
en-GB.description:
Tune Shifter gives you control over any audio or video in Safari.

• Speed: from 0.5x to 2x, with quick presets
• Preserve pitch: change speed without voices sounding higher or lower (or turn it off for the “slowed” effect)
• Reverb: add real-time depth to the sound
• Volume: control the page player's volume (on Mac)
• Settings are saved per site and carry over to the next videos

Works on the video and music sites you use every day.

How to turn it on:
• iPhone and iPad: Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions > Tune Shifter
• Mac: Safari > Settings > Extensions > Tune Shifter

No accounts, no ads and no data collection. The extension only acts on the sites you give it access to.
